part: ch. 60, part 1 — Solomon's Lament for Zion
source: Carl Bezold, Kebra Nagast: Die Herrlichkeit der Könige (Munich, 1905), ch. 60, part 1 of 2 — public domain. Geʿez text as in Ran HaCohen's Unicode edition of Bezold (tau.ac.il/~hacohen/KN, from Michal Jerabek's 1995 digitization), archived and checked against Bezold's printed page. Per-sign transliteration derived mechanically from Unicode; word-level romanization auto-generated (schwa-reduced) and approximate. Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: Solomon, realizing that the Ark of the Covenant (Zion) has gone from Israel, goes into his tent and weeps. He reminds God of the covenants with Noah, Abraham, Isaac, Israel, Moses and Aaron, recalls David's wish and his own building of the Temple, and then pours out a litany of loss, with the refrain አሌለነ 'woe to us', confessing that Israel's sin brought this. Eight short sentences affirm that God alone governs. The part ends mid-chapter, with the lament still going.

sentences.i: With Noah your servant, who kept righteousness; with Abraham, who did not transgress your commandment; with Isaac your child, who cleansed his body of the defilement of sin; and with Israel your holy one, whom you multiplied by the Holy Spirit and named him — after your own (?) — Israel;
sentences.n: A list of the covenant partners, each introduced by ምስለ 'with' (ወምስለ 'and with'). Noah (Genesis 9), Abraham (Genesis 17), Isaac, Israel (Jacob renamed, Genesis 32:28). ዘ- 'who' begins each relative clause: ዘዐቀባ 'who guarded it', ዘኢተዐደወ 'who did not cross over' (ተዐደወ), ዘአንጽሐ 'who made clean', ዘአስተባዛኅከ 'whom you made numerous'. ርስሐተ ኀጢአት 'defilement-of sin' is a construct chain. Two doubtful points: ሰመይኮ is 'you named him' (-ከ + ሁ contracts to -ኮ); but አሠረ ዚአከ is obscure (?): አሠር is 'track' and its construct አሠረ is used as a preposition 'after', so perhaps 'after yours'. Bezold's text has a stray repeated እስራኤል ፤ right after the ፤; I joined it to this unit rather than leave a one-word unit (source oddity kept in t).

sentences.i: And with Moses and Aaron, your priests, in whose days you brought the Ark of the Law down from heaven to earth for the children of Jacob, your inheritance, together with your law and your commandment, after the likeness of the order of the angels;
sentences.n: ወምስለ continues the list. ካህናቲከ 'your priests' (plural of ካህን + ከ). እለ is the plural relative 'who/those who' (cf. ዘ- singular); በመዋዕሊሆሙ 'in their days'. አውረድካ 'you brought down her' (አውረደ causative of ወረደ 'descend'). The Kebra Nagast's doctrine is that the Ark is heavenly and was lowered to earth. ደቂቀ ያዕቆብ 'children-of Jacob' (construct chain; ደቂቅ 'children, sons'). በአርአያ ሥርዐተ መላእክት: ሥርዐት 'order, ordinance'; the earthly law copies the heavenly order (compare Exodus 25:40).

sentences.i: For you had first established (?) Zion as the dwelling of your glory on the mountain of your sanctuary; and in the second instance you gave it (?) to Moses, that he should take care (?) to make her on earth and to set her in the Tent of Testimony, so that you too would come there from the mountain of your sanctuary and make them hear your word, that they might walk in your commandment.
sentences.n: Heavenly Zion (the first, in heaven) and its earthly copy (the second, given to Moses) is the theological point; Exodus 25–26 (the tabernacle, 'tent of testimony', ደብተራ ዘስምዕ). አቅደምከ 'you did first' (አቅደመ causative of ቀደመ). ሳርሮታ is unclear to me — I take it as an infinitive 'founding/establishing her' with ታ 'her' (?). ለጽዮን / ለማኅደረ: ለ- marks the object / 'as, for'. ወበዳግምሰ 'and, the second time'. ወሀብኮለሙሴ is printed as one word: ወሀብኮ ለሙሴ 'you gave him/it to Moses' (-ኮ = -ከ + ሁ); what the -ሁ of ወሀብኮ refers to is unclear (?); the ከመ clause gives the purpose. ከመ + subjunctive 'so that' (ያሰኒ 'that he do well, take care' (? from አሠነየ), ያንብራ, ይሖሩ). Source oddity: ታስ ፡ ምዖሙ is one word ታስምዖሙ 'you make them hear' (አስምዐ) wrongly spaced; kept.

sentences.n: David's wish to build the Temple (2 Samuel 7:1–7; the words echo Isaiah 66:1–2 'what house will you build for me, and what is the place of my rest? my hand made all these'). ነቢይከ 'your prophet' (Nathan, if 2 Samuel 7 is meant). አይኑ = አይ 'which, what' + the particle -ኑ. ፈቀደ ይሕንጽ 'he wished (that) he build'. ሰሚዖ 'having heard' (converb). ዘይቤ 'who said'. ዘኵሎ ይመልክ 'who rules everything' (መለከ 'to reign'). sentences.n: Compare 1 Kings 8:10–11, the glory filling the house. The verb መልአ 'filled/was full' has no stated subject (?): 'the house was filled' is my reading; it could be 'it filled the house'. ቤት ስብሐቲከ 'house of your glory' is read as a genitive group, though ቤት here lacks the construct ending ቤተ. ኵሉ ዓለም ምሉእ መለኮትከ 'all the world full of your divinity' (ምሉእ 'full'). ተፈሣሕነ ሕዝብከ 'we rejoiced, your people' (apposition). በነጽሮ 'in the seeing of' (infinitive with በ-).

sentences.i: And from then on — today is the third year — you snatched our light from us, so that you might give light to those in darkness; you took our glory, so that you might glorify the lacking; you destroyed our awesomeness, so that you might make awesome the one who was not awesome; you took our life, so that you might build up the one whose life is far from you.
sentences.n: Solomon states a paradox: what Israel loses, others gain. In three of the four parallel ከመ-clauses ('so that you might...') the perfect verb takes ለ- + 'our X' (the object marked and doubled by -ኣ, as in አውረድካ ለታቦተ above); the other has the plain object ግርማነ after አጥፋእከ: ብርሃንነ 'our light', ክብርነ 'our glory', ግርማነ 'our awesomeness', ሕይወትነ 'our life'. This is the first hint that the Ark's loss means gain for another people — Ethiopia, in the story. Source oddities kept in t: አ ፡ ጥፋእከ is one word አጥፋእከ ('you destroyed') split by a wordspace; ትሕንጾለዘ is ትሕንጾ ለዘ fused. The endings -ካ in መሠጥካ ነሠትካ are 2nd masc. -ከ + the object suffix -ኣ 'it' (as in አውረድካ above), doubled by the ለ- phrase; compare plain አጥፋእከ ግርማነ. ርሕቀ in the last clause is read as a verb, 'was/is far' (?), not as a noun 'distance'. ኅሱራን 'the lacking/poor' (ኅሱር). ዘ ኢኮነ ግሩመ 'who was not awesome'.

sentences.n: The mourning cry begins. አሌሊተ is አሌ 'woe' + ሊተ 'to me' ('woe to me'); the refrain below, አሌለነ, is አሌ + ለነ 'woe to us' (written once as two words, አሌ ፡ ለነ). እበኪ 'I will weep, let me weep' (1st sg imperfect/subjunctive). ተንሥእ 'arise' (imperative) and ብኪ 'weep!' — Solomon calls on his dead father David. እግዝእትነ 'our Lady' (እግዝእት 'mistress'): the Ark/Zion, feminine. ተሀየየነ 'turned from us' (?) as above. ደቂቅከ 'your children' (David's descendants).

sentences.l: Woe-to-me, because we-turned-from(?) commandment-of God-our, we-became lacking on earth; priests-too not-we-did-well, and-kings-too not-we-made-straight judgment to-child-of the-dead;
sentences.i: Woe to me! Because we turned away (?) from the commandment of our God, we became lacking on the earth: as for the priests, we did not act well; as for the kings, we did not set judgment straight for the orphan;
sentences.n: በእንተ ዘ- 'because of the fact that'. ኮነ is here 1st plural 'we became' (ኮነ = ኮንነ; the same reading below). ኅሱራነ 'lacking ones' (accusative). -ኒ on ካህናትኒ and ነገሥትኒ is 'also/even'. ኢያሠነይነ and ኢያርታዕነ are 1st plural, 'we did not do well', 'we did not make judgment straight', said in turn of the priests and the kings (the speaker may include himself among them); ኢያርታዕነ ፍትሐ (አርትዐ 'make straight/right'; ኢ- negation). እጓለ ማውታ 'orphan' is literally 'offspring-of the dead' (a construct chain); the Bible demands justice for orphans, e.g. Psalm 82:3, Isaiah 1:17.

glossary.ለማኅደርየ: ማኅደር — for my dwelling (ለ- 'for' + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ለምክሩ: ምክር — his plan, counsel (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ለምዕራፍየ: ምዕራፍ — for my rest (ለ- 'for' + noun 'resting place' + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ለሥላሴ: ሥላሴ — to the Trinity (ለ- 'to' + noun, fem.)
glossary.ለርኵስ: ርኵስ — uncleanness, the unclean (ለ- marking the object + noun/adjective)
glossary.ለስምከ: ስም — for your name (ለ- 'for' + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ለብርሃንነ: ብርሃን — our light (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ለታቦተ: ታቦት — to/of the ark (ለ- + noun, construct 'ark of') · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (ወንሥኣ ለታቦተ ሕጉ 'and take the Ark of his law')
glossary.ለኅሊናሁ: ኅሊና — his purpose, thought (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ለኅሱራን: ኅሱር — the lacking, the wanting (ለ- 'to' + adjective, plural ኅሱራን, as noun)
glossary.ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ) · 'over us' (ንገሢ ለነ 'reign over us')
glossary.ለንጽሕ: ንጽሕ — purity (ለ- marking the object + noun)
glossary.ለአበዊነ: አብ — to our fathers (ለ- + plural አበው, አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
glossary.ለእግዝእትነ: እግዝእት — our lady, for/of our lady (ለ- + noun, fem. + -ነ '1cp our'; marks the object, doubled by the suffix of ነሢኦታ)
glossary.ለእጓለ: እጓል — to the child of (ለ- + noun, construct 'child of'; እጓለ ማውታ 'orphan')
glossary.ለክብርነ: ክብር — our glory (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ለኵናተ: ኵናት — to the spears of (ለ- 'to' + noun, construct 'spear of')
glossary.ለወለተ: ወለት — of the daughter of (ለ- 'of, for' + noun, fem., construct 'daughter of')
glossary.ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
glossary.ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
glossary.ለጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — justice, righteousness (ለ- + noun; naming what suffix -ā pointed to)
glossary.ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
glossary.ላሐዋ: ላሐወ — to lament, wail; here uncertain: perhaps 'how/where (he) lamented' or a noun 'lament' (chapter heading; G root l-ḥ-w; the form has the shape of a 3fp perfect, which does not suit Solomon as subject; unclear without Dillmann) (?)
glossary.ሐነጽከ: ሐነጸ — you built (2ms perfect, G, ḥ-n-ṣ)
glossary.ሐኒጾ: ሐነጸ — building, to build (verbal noun / infinitive ሐኒጾ, G, ḥ-n-ṣ; 'I finished building')
glossary.ሕብልያ: ሕብል — bonds, bondmen (noun, rope, cord; ሕብልያ read as a predicate plural 'bondmen' after ኮኑ); form and sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ሕዝበከ: ሕዝብ — your people (noun, accusative + -ከ '2ms your'; apposition to Israel)
glossary.ሕፃናቲነ: ሕፃን — our little ones, children (noun, plural ሕፃናት, stem ሕፃናቲ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.መሥዋዕተ: መሥዋዕት — offering, sacrifice (construct 'offering of') · also accusative 'a sacrifice' (ያዐርጉ መሥዋዕተ 'they offer a sacrifice')
glossary.መከረ: መከረ — he took counsel, advised (3ms perf., G, m-k-r)
glossary.ማውታ: ሙት — the dead; carrion (plural ማውታ, cf. ዕጓለ ማውታ 'orphan', lit. 'child of the dead'; sense here uncertain)
glossary.ምስሌየ: ምስለ — with me (preposition, stem ምስሌ- + -የ '1cs me')
glossary.ምዖሙ: አስምዐ — rest of ታስምዖሙ: '-them' (ሙ '3mp them'; continues the verb ወታስ 'and you make them hear')
glossary.ሣልሲት: ሣልስ — third (ordinal adjective, fem. ሣልሲት, agreeing with ዓመታ)
glossary.ረዳእየ: ረዳኢ — my helper (noun + -የ '1cs my'; predicate after እንዘ አንተ)
glossary.ርሕቀ: ርሕቅ — distance, remoteness (noun, construct 'distance of'; the lemma is inferred from the form: ርሕቀት would give construct ርሕቀተ, and Dillmann is unavailable, so unconfirmed) · here a verb ርሕቀ (ርሕቀ 'was far, was distant', 3ms perfect, G, r-ḥ-q), as in ርሕቀ ሕይወቱ እምኔከ 'his life was far from you', not the construct noun
glossary.ርሡኣኒነ: ርሡእ — our old men (noun (?), plural ርሡኣን + -ነ '1cp our'); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ርስተከ: ርስት — your inheritance (noun, fem., accusative + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ርትዕ: ርትዕ — righteousness, uprightness (noun; subject of the 3fs verb ኀለፈት)
glossary.ርእስየ: ርእስ — myself, my head (noun + -የ '1cs my'; በእንተ ርእስየ 'for myself')
glossary.ሰሚዖ: ሰምዐ — having heard, hearing (verbal noun / converb ሰሚዖ, G, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
glossary.ሳርሮታ: ሰረረ — founding her, establishing her (infinitive-like noun + -ታ, i.e. infixed -t- + -ኣ '3fs her', Zion); the lemma, root and sense are inferred from context and unconfirmed (?)
glossary.ስምነዮምሰ: ዮም — today indeed (adverb ዮም + contrastive -ሰ), written fused with the preceding ስምነ 'our name' (ስም + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ስብሐቲከ: ስብሐት — your glory (noun, fem., stem ስብሐቲ- + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ቀደምት: ቀዳማይ — former, ancient, first (adjective, plural ቀደምት, agreeing with አበዊነ 'our fathers') (?)
glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
glossary.ቅዱስከ: ቅዱስ — your holy one (adjective as noun + -ከ '2ms your'; in apposition to Israel)
glossary.ቊልዔከ: ቍልዔ — your child, your boy (noun + -ከ '2ms your'; in apposition to Isaac)
glossary.በመንፈስ: መንፈስ — by the spirit (በ- 'by, in' + noun; በመንፈስ ቅዱስ 'by the Holy Spirit')
glossary.በመዋዕሊሆሙ: መዋዕል — in their days (በ- 'in' + plural መዋዕል, stem መዋዕሊ- + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.በመዋዕልየኑ: መዋዕል — in my days, in my lifetime (በ- 'in' + plural መዋዕል + -የ '1cs my' + -ኑ, read as the interrogative enclitic) (?)
glossary.በትእዛዝከ: ትእዛዝ — in your commandment (በ- 'in' + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.በኀሳርነ: ኀሳር — by our loss (በ- 'by, through' + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.በኀጢአትነ: ኀጢአት — by our sin (በ- 'by, through' + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.በነጽሮ: ነጸረ — by seeing (በ- + verbal noun ነጽሮ of ነጸረ 'look')
glossary.በአርአያ: አርአያ — after the pattern of, in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በከያ: በከየ — they wept (3fp perfect, G, b-k-y; subject አቤራቲነ)
glossary.ባሕቱ: ባሕቱ — but, however, nevertheless (conjunction; አላ ባሕቱ 'but nevertheless')
glossary.ቤተከ: ቤት — your house (noun, accusative, stem ቤተ- + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ቤት: ቤት — house (noun) · construct 'house of' (ቤት ስብሐቲከ 'house of your glory'; ሰብአ ቤት 'men of the house')
glossary.ብካየ: ብካይ — weeping (noun, accusative; cognate object of በከየ 'wept', ብካየ መሪረ 'bitter weeping')
glossary.ተሀየየነ: ተሀየየ — he turned away from us (3ms perfect, Gt stem, root h-y-y, + -ነ '1cp us'); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ተሀየየኒ: ተሀየየ — he turned away from me (3ms perfect, Gt stem + -ኒ '1cs me'); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ተሀየይከ: ተሀየየ — you turned away, abandoned (2ms perfect, Gt stem, root h-y-y); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ተመነነ: መነነ — was despised (3ms perfect, Gt stem ተመነነ, passive of መነነ 'despise'); in በኀጢአትነ ተመነነ the same spelling stands for 1cp 'we were despised' (= ተመነንነ, one ን written)
glossary.ተመይጠት: ተመይጠ — it turned (3fs perfect, Gt stem of ሜጠ 'turn', root m-y-ṭ)
glossary.ተመጠወ: ተመጠወ — was handed over, given up (3ms perfect, Gt stem of መጠወ)
glossary.ተምዐዕከነ: ተምዕዐ — you were angry with us (2ms perfect, Gt stem, root m-ʿ-ʿ + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ተምዕዐ: ተምዕዐ — he was angry (3ms perfect, Gt stem, root m-ʿ-ʿ)
glossary.ተረስዐት: ተረስዐ — it was forgotten (3fs perfect, Gt stem, passive; root r-s-ʿ)
glossary.ተሰደድነ: ሰደደ — we were driven out, expelled (1cp perfect, Gt stem ተሰደደ, passive of ሰደደ)
glossary.ተቀሠፍነ: ተቀሠፈ — we were scourged, struck (1cp perfect, Gt stem, passive of ቀሠፈ)
glossary.ተነሥተ: ተነሠተ — was taken away (3ms perfect, Gt stem, passive of ነሠተ 'take away, seize', as in ነሠትካ above; if from ነሥአ the spelling would be ተነሥአ) (?)
glossary.ተንሥእ: ተንሥአ — arise! (2ms imperative, Gt, root n-s-ʾ)
glossary.ተግባራ: ተግባር — her service, her deed (noun + -ሃ '3fs her', Zion/Ark; object of ኢያሠነይነ)
glossary.ተፍጻሜተ: ተፍጻሜት — end of (noun, construct 'end of'; እስከ ተፍጻሜተ መዋዕሊነ)
glossary.ታብርህ: አብርሀ — that you give light, enlighten (2ms subjunctive, causative of በርሀ 'shine'; after ከመ)
glossary.ታክብሮሙ: አክበረ — that you glorify them (2ms subjunctive, causative of ከበረ 'be heavy, honoured', + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ታግርሞ: አግረመ — that you make him awesome (2ms subjunctive, causative of ገረመ + -ኦ '3ms him'); root uncertain (?)
glossary.ትሕንጾለዘ: ሐነጸ — that you build him, build up (2ms subjunctive, G, ḥ-n-ṣ + -ኦ '3ms him') + ለዘ 'for him who'; written as one word
glossary.ትምጻእ: መጽአ — that you come (2ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ትቤሎ: ብህለ — you said to him (2ms perfect ትቤ, the same form as 3fs; defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ትነሥኣ: ነሥአ — you take her (2ms imperfect, G, n-ś-ʾ + -ኣ '3fs her', the Ark); first with the question sense 'are you to take her?', then after ዘ- 'that you take her'
glossary.ኀለየ: ኀለየ — he thought, reflected (3ms perfect, ḫ-l-y)
glossary.ኀለፈት: ኀለፈ — it passed away (3fs perfect, ḫ-l-f)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam')
glossary.ኀይመቱ: ኀይመት — his tent (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; the sense 'tent' is read from context and unconfirmed) (?)
glossary.ኀጢአት: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, fem.; here genitive after construct ርስሐተ 'defilement of sin')
glossary.ኅሱራነ: ኅሱር — lacking, deficient (adjective, accusative plural ኅሱራነ)
glossary.ኅስርት: ኅሱር — lacking, deficient (adjective, fem. ኅስርት; apposition to the daughter of Ethiopia)
glossary.ነሐበልዮሙ: ሐበለ — we bind them (1cp imperfect, G, ḥ-b-l, + -ዮሙ '3mp them'); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ነሠትካ: ነሠተ — you took (it), seized (2ms perfect, G + -ኣ 'it'); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ነሢአ: ነሥአ — taking, to take (verbal noun / infinitive ነሢአ, G, n-ś-ʾ; 'before taking my soul')
glossary.ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ነፍስየ: ነፍስ — my soul, my life (noun, fem. + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.አ: አ — [ʾa], question particle (?) (written detached from the verb) · not a question particle in አ ጥፋእከ (ch. 60): the detached first syllable of አጥፋእከ (አጥፍአ 'you destroyed'), whose rest is written as the next word ጥፋእከ
glossary.አሌለነ: አሌ — woe to us (interjection አሌ + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.አሌሊተ: አሌ — woe to me (interjection አሌ 'woe' + ሊተ '1cs to me', written as one word; repeated for emphasis)
glossary.አሠረ: አሠር — track, footprint; አሠረ እሙ 'behind his mother' (noun, construct, used as preposition 'after')
glossary.አስተራኰሰ: አስተራኰሰ — he made unclean (?) (3ms perfect, ast- stem of a root r-k-s, cf. ርኵስ 'unclean'; lemma and sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.አቅደምከ: አቅደመ — you did first, put first, established beforehand (2ms perfect, causative of ቀደመ 'precede'; -ከ is the 2ms subject ending) (?)
glossary.አበዊነ: አብ — our fathers (noun, plural አበው, stem አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.አበይዋ: አበየ — they refused her (3mp perfect, G, ʾ-b-y + -ኣ '3fs her', ንጽሕ)
glossary.አባእክዋ: አብአ — you brought her in (2ms perfect አባእከ, causative of ቦአ 'enter', + -ኣ '3fs her', the Ark)
glossary.አቤራቲነ: አቤራት — our matrons (a guess) (noun, fem. plural, stem አቤራቲ- + -ነ '1cp our'); the lemma is reconstructed from the form and unconfirmed (?)
glossary.አኅሰረ: አኅሰረ — he caused to lack, diminished (3ms perfect, causative of ኅሰረ 'lack')
glossary.አንስቲያነ: ብእሲት — our women (noun, plural አንስት, stem አንስቲያ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.አንብዓ: አንብዕ — tears of (noun, collective 'tears', construct አንብዓ 'tears of'; አንብዓ አንስቲያነ)
glossary.አንተሰ: አንተ — you indeed (2ms pronoun + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.አንተኒ: አንተ — you also, you too (2ms pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.አእመርኩ: አእመረ — I knew, I have come to know (1cs perfect, stem አእመረ 'know', root ʿ-m-r)
glossary.አኮኑ: አኮ — is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.አውረድካ: አውረደ — you brought down her (2ms perfect, causative of ወረደ 'descend', + -ኣ '3fs her', the Ark)
glossary.አውየዉ: አውየወ — they cried out, wailed (3mp perfect; related to the noun አውያት 'wailing') (?)
glossary.አይኑ: አይ — which? what? (interrogative adjective + enclitic -ኑ); አይኑ ቤት 'what house?'
glossary.ኢተሐሰወ: ተሐሰወ — it was not proved false, did not fail (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, Gt stem of ሐሰወ 'lie')
glossary.ኢትሔሱ: ሐሰወ — you do not lie, do not belie (ኢ- 'not' + 2ms imperfect, G, ḥ-s-w)
glossary.ኢትነጽር: ነጸረ — do not look (ኢ- 'not' + 2ms imperfect ትነጽር, G, n-ṣ-r; used as a prohibition)
glossary.ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)
glossary.ኢያሠነይነ: አሠነየ — we did not do well (ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, causative of ሠነየ 'be good')
glossary.ኢያርታዕነ: አርትዐ — we did not set straight (ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, causative of ርትዐ 'be straight, right')
glossary.ኢይትከሀለከ: ተከሀለ — it is not possible for you, it is not for you (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, Gt stem, root k-h-l, impersonal, + -ከ '2ms to you')
glossary.እምላዕሌነ: ላዕል — from upon us (እም- 'from' + preposition ላዕል, stem ላዕሌ- + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.እምሐቌከ: ሐቌ — from your loins (እም- 'from' + noun 'loins, hip' + -ከ '2ms your'); lemma form uncertain (?)
glossary.እምርስሐተ: ርስሐት — from the defilement of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct 'defilement of')
glossary.እምቀደምከ: ቀደመ — before you (እም- 'from' + ቀደመ 'precede' in the 2ms perfect ቀደምከ, so literally 'from you preceded'; or the noun ቀደም 'front' + -ከ '2ms you'; reading uncertain) (?)
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምኔከ: እም — from you (preposition እም with suffix -ኔከ '2ms')
glossary.እምደቂቅከ: ደቂቅ — from your children (እም- 'from' + plural noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እምደብረ: ደብር — from the mountain of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct 'mountain of')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እበኪ: በከየ — I will weep, let me weep (1cs imperfect, G, b-k-y)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እደዊየ: እድ — my hands (noun, plural እደው, stem እደዊ- + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኪዳነከ: ኪዳን — your covenant (noun, accusative + -ከ '2ms your'; object of ኢትዔምፅ)
glossary.ኪዳንከ: ኪዳን — your covenant (noun + -ከ '2ms your', genitive after construct ታቦተ)
glossary.ካህናቲከ: ካህን — your priests (plural ካህናት, stem ካህናቲ- + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ክብራ: ክብር — her glory (noun + -ሃ 'her', anticipating ለጽዮን 'of Zion'; not a construct)
glossary.ክብርት: ክቡር — honored (adjective, fem. ክብርት; apposition to the daughter of Zion)
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two')
glossary.ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወሀብኮለሙሴ: ወሀበ — and you gave him/it to Moses (ወ- 'and' + 2ms perfect, G, w-h-b + -ኦ '3ms him/it' + ለ- 'to' + ሙሴ), written as one word; suffix reference uncertain (?)
glossary.ወላሐዋደናግሊነ: ላሐወ — and lamented our virgins (ወ- 'and' + 3fp perfect ላሐዋ, G, l-ḥ-w, written together with ደናግል 'virgins' (plural of ድንግል) + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወሐነጽኩ: ሐነጸ — and I built (ወ- 'and' + 1cs perfect, G, ḥ-n-ṣ)
glossary.ወሐወጽከ: ሐወጸ — and you came in, visited (ወ- 'and' + 2ms perfect, G, ḥ-w-ṣ); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ወመልአ: መልአ — and he filled (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-l-ʾ)
glossary.ወመሠጥካ: መሠጠ — and you snatched her/it (ወ- 'and' + 2ms perfect, G, m-ś-ṭ + -ኣ 'it'; with ለብርሃንነ marking the object)
glossary.ወማሰነት: ማሰን — and ruin (ወ- 'and' + noun ማሰነት 'ruin, destruction'; it stands before ሀገርነ in the sense 'ruin of our country', though a construct ending would be expected); form uncertain (?)
glossary.ወሜጥከ: ሜጠ — and you turned (ወ- 'and' + 2ms perfect, G, m-y-ṭ)
glossary.ወሞገስነ: ሞገስ — and our favor (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወሦዕኩ: ሠዐወ — and I offered, sacrificed (ወ- 'and' + 1cs perfect, G, ś-ʿ-w); root uncertain (?)
glossary.ወሰመይኮ: ሰመየ — and you named him (ወ- 'and' + 2ms perfect, G, s-m-y + -ሁ '3ms him', -ከ + -ሁ contracted to -ኮ)
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወበከየ: በከየ — and he wept (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, b-k-y)
glossary.ወበዳግምሰ: ዳግም — and in the second time, and secondly indeed (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'in' + ዳግም 'second time' + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወብኪ: በከየ — and weep! (ወ- 'and' + 2ms imperative, G, b-k-y)
glossary.ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተገሠጽነ: ተገሠጸ — and we were rebuked (ወ- 'and' + 1cp perfect, Gt stem, passive of ገሠጸ)
glossary.ወተፈሣሕነ: ተፈሥሐ — and we rejoiced (ወ- 'and' + 1cp perfect, Gt stem, f-ś-ḥ; written here with ሣ, so the lemma spelling is normalized) (?)
glossary.ወታስ: አስምዐ — and that you make hear (ወ- 'and' + first syllables ታስ- of 2ms subjunctive ታስምዕ, causative of ሰምዐ; the word ታስምዖሙ is split here by a wordspace)
glossary.ወትእዛዝከ: ትእዛዝ — and your commandment (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and he took her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, n-ś-ʾ + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወነቢያትኒ: ነቢይ — and the prophets too (ወ- 'and' + plural ነቢያት + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወነገሥትኒ: ንጉሥ — and the kings too (ወ- 'and' + plural ነገሥት + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወንፄውዎሙ: ፄወወ — and we enslave, take captive them (ወ- 'and' + 1cp imperfect, G, ṣ-w-w + -ሙ '3mp them'); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአስምዑነ: አስምዐ — and they made us hear, warned us (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, causative of ሰምዐ + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወአይኑ: አይ — and which? and what? (ወ- 'and' + interrogative አይ + enclitic -ኑ)
glossary.ወአፍቀርዋ: አፍቀረ — and they loved her (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, causative; + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወኢሰማዕነ: ሰምዐ — and we did not hear, did not listen (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ወኢተገሠጽነ: ተገሠጸ — and we were not corrected, not rebuked (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, Gt stem, passive of ገሠጸ)
glossary.ወኢትዔምፅ: ዐመፀ — and you do not break, do not act unjustly toward (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2ms imperfect, G, ʿ-m-ṣ)
glossary.ወኢያሠነይነ: አሠነየ — and we did not do well (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, causative of ሠነየ 'be good')
glossary.ወእምአሜሃሰ: አሜሃ — and from then indeed, and from that time (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + adverb አሜሃ 'then' + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወከልሑ: ከልሐ — and they shouted (ወ- + 3mp perfect, k-l-ḥ)
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወዐብየ: ዐብየ — and it grew, became great (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, ʿ-b-y)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወያንብራ: አንበረ — and that he set her (ወ- 'and' + 3ms subjunctive, causative of ነበረ 'sit', + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወፄዋ: ፄዋ — and captives (ወ- 'and' + noun, predicate; 'captive, slave')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውስጥ: ውስጥ — inside, within (adverb / noun; ሰብአ ውስጥ 'men of the inside, insiders')
glossary.ዓመታ: ዓመት — her year, year (noun, fem. + -ሃ '3fs her', resumptive; ሣልሲት ዓመታ 'the third year of it')
glossary.ዘበመዋዕልየ: መዋዕል — that in my days (ዘ- 'that, which' + በ- 'in' + plural መዋዕል + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ዘባንነ: ዘባን — our back (noun + -ነ '1cp our'; subject of ተመጠወ)
glossary.ዘተሀየይነ: ተሀየየ — that we turned away (ዘ- 'that' + 1cp perfect, Gt stem, root h-y-y); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ዘተካየድከ: ተካየደ — which you covenanted, made as covenant (ዘ- 'which' + 2ms perfect, tafāʿala stem, root k-y-d) (?)
glossary.ዘአስተባዛኅከ: አስተባዛኀ — whom you multiplied (ዘ- 'whom' + 2ms perfect, ast- stem with long ā, root b-z-ḫ 'be many'; the lemma spelling is inferred from the form and the stem shape is unconfirmed) (?)
glossary.ዘአንጽሐ: አንጽሐ — who purified, cleansed (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms perfect, causative of ንጽሐ 'be pure', root n-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ዘኢተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — who did not transgress (ዘ- 'who' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, Gt stem, root ʿ-d-w)
glossary.ዘኵሎ: ኵሉ — who (over) all (ዘ- + ኵሉ accusative; ዘኵሎ ይመልክ 'who rules all') · 'all', in loose apposition after ዘገብራ (ዘገብራ ዘኵሎ 'that made it, all'; the construction is uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘወፅአ: ወፅአ — that which went out (ዘ- 'which' + 3ms perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘዐቀባ: ዐቀበ — who kept, guarded it (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms perfect, G, ʿ-q-b + -ኣ '3fs it'; ዐቀባ ለጽድቅ 'kept righteousness', object marked by ለ-)
glossary.ዘዘንተ: ዝንቱ — that this (ዘ- 'that' + accusative demonstrative ዘንተ; ዘዘንተ ሐነጽከ 'that you built this') (?)
glossary.ዘያከብር: አክበረ — who honors (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, causative of ከበረ)
glossary.ዘያገብእ: አግብአ — who brings back, restores (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, causative of ገብአ 'return')
glossary.ዘያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — who loves (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
glossary.ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ዘገብራ: ገብረ — which made it, that made her (ዘ- 'which' + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r + -ኣ '3fs it')
glossary.የሀንጽ: ሐነጸ — he will build (3ms imperfect, G, ḥ-n-ṣ)
glossary.የአብያ: አበየ — he will refuse her/it (3ms imperfect, G, ʾ-b-y + -ኣ '3fs it', anticipating ለኅሊናሁ)
glossary.ያሰኒ: አሠነየ — that he do well, take care (after ከመ, read as 3ms subjunctive of አሠነየ, causative of ሠነየ 'be good'; the form does not match the regular ያሠንይ, so root and sense are uncertain) (?)
glossary.ያነጽሕ: አንጽሐ — he will cleanse (3ms imperfect, causative of ንጽሐ 'be pure')
glossary.ያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — he loves (3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
glossary.ይሕንጽ: ሐነጸ — that he build (3ms subjunctive, G, after ከመ)
glossary.ይመልክ: መልከ — he rules, reigns over (3ms imperfect, G, m-l-k)
glossary.ይሣሀል: ሣሀለ — he will have mercy, show mercy (3ms imperfect, root ś-h-l, cf. ሣህል 'mercy')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይትቃወማ: ተቃወመ — he will oppose her (3ms imperfect, tafāʿala stem, root q-w-m, + -ኣ '3fs her', anticipating ለምክሩ)
glossary.ደቂቅነ: ደቂቅ — our sons (plural noun + -ነ '1cp our') · 'our children' (ደቂቅ plural 'children' + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገሠጹነ: ገሠጸ — they rebuked us (3mp perfect, G, g-ś-ṣ + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ገቢሮታ: ገብረ — making her (infinitive ገቢሮ 'making' + -ታ, i.e. infixed -t- + -ኣ '3fs her', Zion; ገቢሮታ በዲበ ምድር 'making her on earth')
glossary.ገብርከ: ገብር — your servant (noun + -ከ '2ms your'; in apposition to a name)
glossary.ገጸከ: ገጽ — your face (noun + -ከ '2ms your', stem ገጸ- before the suffix)
glossary.ግሩመ: ግሩም — awesome, fearsome (adjective, accusative/predicate; ኢኮነ ግሩመ 'was not awesome')
glossary.ግርማነ: ግርማ — our awesomeness, our fearsome dignity (noun + -ነ '1cp our'; accusative)
glossary.ጥፋእከ: አጥፍአ — you destroyed (2ms perfect, causative of ጠፍአ 'perish', + subject ending -ከ); ጥፋእከ is the remainder of አጥፋእከ, whose first syllable አ is written detached
glossary.ጸልአ: ጸልአ — he hated (3ms perfect, G, ṣ-l-ʾ)
glossary.ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፈጸምኩ: ፈጸመ — I finished, completed (1cs perfect, G, f-ṣ-m)
